Market today: Inflation fears are back in focus with oil hitting $100, which could pressure interest rates. This is the real driver for your tech/chip heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-50.54%) and SPAL (-34.02%) are still flagged for attention. QQQI (-3.26%) is also marked for a trim.

Watch: Keep an eye on how the market digests the renewed inflation talk and any potential impact on tech valuations.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged positions and watch for inflation signals to dictate market direction.
plays: Trim QQQI at current levels if conviction is low.
Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL further if conviction is low, given their leveraged nature and current losses.
